'''Shattering Wave''' was a [[The Force|Force]] [[Force power|power]] used by [[Tenebrae]]. The ability would manifest as a [[Color/Legends|bluish-purple]] blast in the shape of an orb, which would be directed to its opponent, and it would knock them back, though it was generally not strong enough to send them off their feet. Tenebrae made use of this during the fight that led to his final death.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref>
